title: Maximum Average Subarray I
goal: Find the greatest average of any contiguous subarray of length k.
strategy: Keep exactly k neighboring values. Subtract the outgoing value as each incoming value arrives.

phasePurposes.inspect: Keep exactly k neighboring values. Subtract the outgoing value as each incoming value arrives.
phasePurposes.update: Every window has exactly k entries, so comparing sums also compares averages.
phasePurposes.done: Every window has exactly k entries, so comparing sums also compares averages.

inputRules: Inputs are validated against this algorithm’s domain and the documented visualization size limits.
